source_notes: Prospective bounded exploratory search after research/table2-sigma-v1-20261103.
100M token cap, seeds 6198/1024/7, original per-method micro-batch profile and global batch 64.
Two sigma values x two/four/six HIPE layers at each of the three previous mean-loss settings; three matching four-HIPE-layer settings reused.
XPos uses reference TorchScale decay, scale_base 512, split-half rotary coordinates and no learned absolute position embeddings.
One GPU per SLURM array task, maximum two simultaneous tasks, no DDP.
Select on complete three-seed validation means, report every candidate and failures; no claim that tuning must outperform RoPE.
